about: Issue 462 (ADR-0039 amendment of 14 November 2026; docs/architecture/462-lockout-contract.md §3.5 and §5). The same file is in workforce-deploy bin/tests/; both the sign-in server's policy and the app's PasswordPause must give these answers. Times are UTC. A marker is the later of the account's password change and its unlock. Fix round of 14 November 2026: the throttle never depends on the typed name (no exemption by name or by unlock), a connection or IPv6 /48 where 3 or more real accounts typed the right password in the last 30 days is a workplace and is never throttled, and an IPv6 /48 is throttled after 30 wrong tries. Review of 14 November 2026: an IPv6 /48 workplace is still throttled after 300 wrong tries.
